rationale: Kept safe feedforward+saturation structure but retuned for ~4s extra delay: longer measurement filters (1.8s), symmetric low Kp=0.75 on delay-compensated error y_pred=yf+3.2*rf, true-error integral Ki=0.40 with conditional anti-windup and in-band desensitization, small extra damping Kd=0.6, and 0.6/s output slew limit. Prediction brakes before target to cancel dead-time overshoot; lower gain + slew limit restores phase margin for 5s delay while initial saturation still gives full pump for fast rise.

extra.machine_card: Reservoir with pump u in [0,1], noisy level y in [0,1], drain, ~1-2s lag nominal, threshold nonlinearity (u~0.75 to hold low level), noise <0.02. After change: DC gain and drain unchanged, dead-time/lag increased to ~4-5s before response, effective time-constant ~6s, hold for y=0.6 still ~0.6-0.7. Controller must tolerate 1s to 5s delay without oscillation and hold 0.55-0.65 after 30s.
extra.predicted_behavior: Rise at full 0.92 for ~12-18s (nominal) / ~16-22s (delayed plant), predictive braking starts ~0.07 above target, overshoot <0.05, no sustained limit-cycle. After 30s y stays 0.55-0.65 >70% of time, MAE ~0.03-0.04, energy similar or lower, zero hard violations/overrides on both nominal and 5s-delay plants, confirming delay diagnosis; if gain-loss were true, prediction alone would still leave offset and fail.
extra.diagnosis: Same command now produces same eventual slope but much later. Pre-change E2 u=1.0 from 0.177 rises within ~1s at ~0.020/s; E8 u=0.9 rises immediately at ~0.027/s. Post-change Episode1 u=0.92 from 0.179 stays flat/decays for ~4.8s (0.179->0.152->0.164) then rises 0.224 to 0.361 in 5.6s =0.0245/s; Episode0 u=0.92 from 0.352 flat for ~5s then 0.358->0.465 in 4s =0.0267/s. Steady rate unchanged, dead-time +3-4s. Decay at low u is not faster (0.688->0.527 in 9.6s =-0.018/s vs pre-change E11 -0.021/s at u=0), so drain/outflow not increased and pump DC gain not halved. Extra dead-time explains large overshoot to 0.73 and sustained oscillation period ~35-40s with in-band only 0.35 and MAE ~0.06 despite zero overrides: PI tuned for 1-2s lag winds up during dead-time and P on un-predicted error brakes too late.
